reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 9 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Pelicans.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 204 and 252 total points.

analyst.text: Dejounte Murray's trade request has found no significant market, per ESPN, and he is away from the team with an ankle injury; New Orleans are 5-11 and on the first night of a back-to-back. Oklahoma City have lost four of five, including a first home loss, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander called it a new challenge; Alex Caruso (hip) is questionable. Both sides are unsettled; the angle leans towards an Oklahoma City response at home.
